description: This Java source file defines the User entity class for the application, representing users within the system, including their attributes, relationships, and persistence configurations.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing a user in the system with fields for user details, relationships to groups and merchant store, auditing, and security attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section for the user entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for the user entity.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the user.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name of the user.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the user.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name of the user.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language associated with the user.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language for the user.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Associates a list of groups with the user.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups associated with the user.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store linked to the user.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the user.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the user is active.
